## Summary
The human detail identifies the invalid field, while machine-readable `refusal.surface` and `rejected_value` blame another valid input. This misdirects automated repair.

Reproduced with the official installed `@unbrained/pm-cli` 2026.9.30 on Linux, using disposable synthetic non-Git trackers. No implementation changes are included in this issue.

## Reproduction
```bash
LAB=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$LAB/home" "$LAB/work"
export HOME="$LAB/home" PM_PATH="$LAB/work/.agents/pm"
export PM_GLOBAL_PATH="$LAB/global" PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
cd "$LAB/work"
pm init "$PM_PATH" --defaults --author audit --agent-guidance skip --json >/dev/null
pm create task "Audit sample" --id t1 --description "Execution detail" --json >/dev/null
```
```bash
pm update pm-t1 --priority high --risk invalid --json
pm update pm-t1 --title x --risk invalid --json
pm update pm-t1 --title x --deadline not-a-date --json
pm update pm-missing --title x --json
```

## Actual
For the first command, exit 2:
```json
{"code":"invalid_argument_value","detail":"Invalid risk value \"invalid\". Allowed: low, medium, high, critical","refusal":{"surface":"--priority","rejected_value":"high","exit_code":2}}
```
With title preceding invalid risk or deadline, the refusal instead names `--title` / `x`. A missing-item update also attributes the refusal to a valid title flag. Structured consumers therefore receive different, false repair targets depending on unrelated arguments.

## Expected
Risk validation names `--risk` and `invalid`; deadline validation names `--deadline` and `not-a-date`; a missing item names the ID/lookup surface. If precise attribution is unavailable, omit it rather than inventing an offending flag.

## Implementation plan
1. Carry validator-owned structured metadata (surface, rejected value, legal domain where available) with the typed error from its origin.
2. Have the shared refusal renderer preserve that metadata. Remove fallback attribution based on the first/last supplied flag or argument order.
3. Give lookup and policy errors their own meaningful surfaces, independent of mutation options.
4. Keep detail, recovery and refusal metadata consistent across CLI/SDK adapters; document nullable/absent attribution.
5. Add parameterized conformance tests over validators and argument permutations.

## Regression acceptance
- [ ] Risk, deadline and missing-ID fixtures identify the actual failure
- [ ] Permuting valid title/priority flags never changes attribution
- [ ] Attached values, aliases, multiple invalid inputs and no flagged inputs are covered
- [ ] Error paths do not mutate item state
- [ ] Unknown attribution is omitted; legal-domain values correspond to the blamed field
- [ ] Existing policy-specific missing-field and surface tests remain green

## Ownership and duplicate check
Child of #1363; use as a structured-refusal negative control in #1362. Related closed #1305 fixed require_fields policy metadata. These current ordinary value-validation and missing-item cases require no workflow policy and are not covered by that narrow report. Open and closed issues were searched for refusal and rejected_value.
GH-1365: Agent UX: typed update refusals blame valid flags instead of the field that failed validation

Reported agent-facing contract defect imported from https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1365. Preserve existing shipped foundations. Detailed source observations are dated 2026-09-30 and must be revalidated before implementation.

Risk, deadline and missing-ID fixtures identify the actual failure; Permuting valid title/priority flags never changes attribution; Attached values, aliases, multiple invalid inputs and no flagged inputs are covered; Error paths do not mutate item state; Unknown attribution is omitted; legal-domain values correspond to the blamed field; Existing policy-specific missing-field and surface tests remain green
The public command follows the documented equivalent-option, receipt or recovery contract without changing valid unrelated behavior.
Source report reproduced published 2026.9.30 behavior; current checkout requires fresh reproduction before claiming the defect.
